media_path.description: Absolute path of the source media referenced by the timeline.

otio_path.description: Path of the .otio file -- the canonical IR artifact. All other exports derive from it.

source_start.description: Start in the source media, seconds (rational strings like '84/30' preferred -- exact, no float drift).

duration.description: Segment duration in seconds (rational strings preferred).

qc_passed.description: Whether run_timeline_gates() passed on these segments before checkpointing.
